note: Complete compact replacement for the length-truncated first response. Budget ids, limits, statuses, disposition mapping, and trip protocol are identical to the frozen SAFETY-SPEC.md (sections 4-6; validation checklist section 13) and BUDGETS.json, which this file does not rewrite. The common protocol below applies to every trip case.

on_any_trip: stop at the measurement point; no later stage starts
discard the partial candidate at temp; never rename or publish; candidate.written=false
re-verify original sha256+size against intake and sealed-manifest records (INV-01)
write the RunReceipt atomically (INV-09/INV-10) and preserve it, including crash and invalid runs (E08/E11)
remove private temp with removal evidence, or retain as RETAINED_FOR_CRASH_EVIDENCE with a content manifest
no repair, retry, or regeneration outside the frozen plan (E15)
common_trip_protocol.fail_closed_state: original unchanged + receipt present + zero published candidate bytes
common_trip_protocol.refuse_cdrr_shape: INV-22 refuse shape: extraction sections present, NOT_EXERCISED, empty records

disposition_mapping.builder_side_trip_before_candidate: REFUSE, refusal_family=RESOURCE_BUDGET_EXCEEDED; stages after the trip point NOT_EXERCISED/BUDGET_TRIP_BEFORE_GATE
disposition_mapping.verifier_side_budget_exhaustion: gate ERROR (worse than FAIL); disposition NOT_VERIFIABLE via PR-08; candidate never published as ACCEPT
disposition_mapping.post_hoc_budget_fail_on_completed_candid: G9/G11 FAIL has no REFUSE/REVIEW mapping; disposition NOT_VERIFIABLE via PR-14; recorded as-is, never patched
disposition_mapping.network_use_observed: run-level INVALID_EXPERIMENT, E06_NETWORK_USED_DURING_PROCESSING; overrides document dispositions (INV-23)

probe_rules.no_sealed_file_modified: probes are harness-synthetic, generated at test time (INV-01/E01); each records snippet id, byte size, sha256 in the receipt (E09)
probe_rules.injected_faults: HST cases inject faults into harness-owned stages only; builder/verifier code paths are never modified

trip_cases.trigger: deterministic 9-page harness-synthetic text PDF (TC01-PROBE) exceeds limit 8
harness-synthetic PDF with 1024 tiny indirect objects (TC02-PROBE) exceeds limit 1000
~300000-byte harness-synthetic text PDF (TC03-PROBE) exceeds limit 204800; not a sealed fixture
harness render-accounting stage repeats a render set 20x past the 64000000 px backstop
busy-loop injected into harness-owned VERIFY; supervisor terminates at 600.0 cpu-seconds

receipt.disposition: ERROR (crash/partial receipt; resolved before closure; never ACCEPT)

expected.cdrr_shape: partial CDRR kept as crash evidence; never completed into ACCEPT

trip_cases.trigger: stalled (sleep) harness-owned EXTRACT; supervisor terminates at 600.0 wall-seconds

receipt.disposition: ERROR (crash/partial receipt; resolved before closure; never ACCEPT)

expected.cdrr_shape: partial CDRR kept as crash evidence

trip_cases.trigger: harness stage writes >100 MiB of synthetic intermediates; trip at sampling boundary (limit 104857600)
candidate exceeds 1048576 bytes at write time, before rename (declared oversized HST payload)
network use: harness probe attempts a loopback socket inside the audited worker; the INV-12 sys.addaudithook guard (SOCKET_AUDIT) raises before any connection

receipt.budgets: in-progress stage id recorded; audit event name+timestamp in no_network_evidence.evidence_ref

trip_cases.trigger: verifier-owned measurement point reports its own budget exhaustion on a candidate-bearing run

receipt.budgets: verifier scope ERROR per SAFETY-SPEC status_mapping
receipt.disposition: NOT_VERIFIABLE via PR-08 (gate ERROR worse than FAIL; candidate never published as ACCEPT)

trip_cases.trigger: completed run found to violate its output-size limit during verification

receipt.disposition: NOT_VERIFIABLE via PR-14 (no G9/G11 FAIL to REFUSE/REVIEW mapping; never published as ACCEPT)

trip_cases.trigger: crash receipt preservation: injected non-zero worker exit during APPLY; no autonomous retry (E15); partial receipt and temp state preserved (E08/E11)

receipt.budgets: stages completed before the crash WITHIN_BUDGET; remainder NOT_EXERCISED
receipt.disposition: ERROR (crash/partial receipt; resolved before closure; never ACCEPT)

expected.cdrr_shape: partial CDRR kept as crash evidence

trip_cases.trigger: audit finds a final-path output that bypassed temp-then-rename (INV-10 violation)
trip_cases.stage_stopped: audit finding at close of run

trip_cases.trigger: audit finds temp reuse across documents or a pre-existing temp dir for a live run id (INV-11 violation)

non_trip_cases.purpose: edge-within control: no trip at the exact PAGE_COUNT limit
non_trip_cases.expected: full pipeline runs; all budgets WITHIN_BUDGET; disposition from gates; no trip

non_trip_cases.purpose: sealed-max control with first actual baselines
non_trip_cases.expected: all budgets WITHIN_BUDGET; first actual OBJECT_COUNT/CPU/WALL values recorded; no trip

non_trip_cases.purpose: refusal controls not over-tripped by budget logic
non_trip_cases.expected: refused at intake for their own frozen refusal families; budgets NOT_EXERCISED, never RESOURCE_BUDGET_EXCEEDED
